messages.text:
The "single" test expects that when given `"7"` (no hyphen), `parseRange` should return `{ from: 7, to: 7 }`. The current implementation splits on `-`, and when there's no `-`, the second element of the destructured array is `undefined`, so `Number(undefined)` becomes `NaN`.

The fix is to handle the case where there's no hyphen by defaulting `to` to the same value as `from`.
